title: Muhammad Ali Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Muhammad Ali Mosque: exact aggregate/court and twenty current component controls; cascading pale central/four lower/four corner dome roofs, warm masonry prayer hall, paired tall pencil minarets with projecting balconies, open round-arched court colonnades and small roof cupolas, an octagonal fountain canopy and green/brown clock pavilion. Current plans/most part heights are controlled. Twin82 m finial totals intentionally use the retained overall fact instead of conflicting64 m map tags, with explicit uncertainty. Facade rhythm, clock/fountain dimensions, profiles and internal architecture remain estimates. Six existing shared256² graphs, seven merged roles and four independently budgeted LODs; no copied photographs, fine ornament or furnished interior. The separate eight-vertex central-court octagon 35184990184834 is interpreted as the picture-visible ablution fountain canopy; its exact mapped roof outline and position are retained. Fountain support layout, basin and canopy height remain estimates.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained Q652046 map anchor [31.259647827,30.02905021] and heading -0.7484560352 rad remain unchanged; the separate original reference point is preserved in the source record. Current named Mosque of Muhammad Ali POI and aggregate relation 446128 / feature 52776558579376 identify this mosque. The raw parent has 21 outer vertices and one four-vertex court. Twenty separate current building parts supply prayer hall, central dome/drum, four lower dome controls, four corner caps, paired rear turrets, paired minarets and eastern projecting ranges. Positive X runs southeast toward the prayer hall; the court lies at negative X, so the main court facade faces negative X. Positive Z runs southwest. Facade divisions, court colonnade bays, fountain and clock-tower architecture are picture-led estimates. Separate Al Nasser Mohammad Ibn Qalaun Mosque, Citadel fortifications, museums and other buildings stay host content. The separate eight-vertex central-court octagon 35184990184834 is interpreted as the picture-visible ablution fountain canopy; its exact mapped roof outline and position are retained. Fountain support layout, basin and canopy height remain estimates.
